notes.title: Steam Screenshots Enabled and Nvidia G-sync Fix
notes.content:
By your request we have enabled the use of Steam Screenshots via the Steam Overlay. 

We have also implemented a fix for users with Nvidia G-sync monitors who were experiencing problems when the game ran at 120fps.

Merry Christmas Everyone :)

notes.title: Graphical Improvements
notes.content: We hope you like TACTICAL's new look!

notes.title: Steam Cloud
notes.content: In response to your feedback we have enabled the use of Steam Cloud with our game.

notes.title: Updated Visuals
notes.content: We have updated the visuals for each level to focus attention on the playable area. We have also given each chapter its own colour to highlight progress between chapters and improve the games aesthetic.
